title: PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware JSON files (if needed).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the PCR plate, tip racks, and any other required labware in the specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; refer to the app’s calibration tips or support articles for guidance.

steps.title: Transfer reagents for PCR
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip for each transfer, dispense samples, primers, BigDye, and water into the clean PCR plate. Pipette small volumes ranging from 1 µl to 6 µl. Ensure that the total number of sample‑primer combinations does not exceed 96, otherwise the protocol will raise an exception.
